Research approach

A result needs a method.

The model uses chosen pricing assumptions and simulated outcomes. Its calculations are implemented and testable; empirical claims require a separate dataset and a documented evaluation.

The next step is to document dated option observations, calibrate on one sample and evaluate later observations separately. Pricing errors and failed hypotheses belong alongside useful findings.
